meta.title: SQLite PRAGMA Reference - S-Jiffy
meta.description: 50+ commonly used SQLite PRAGMA statements with parameters, return values, and descriptions; click a card to copy the full statement.
desc: 50+ commonly used SQLite PRAGMA statements with parameters, return values, and descriptions; click a card to copy the full statement.
ui.2: Click any card to copy the PRAGMA statement.
ui.5: Controls support for legacy pre-3.7 file formats (deprecated).
ui.6: Makes INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE return the number of affected rows (deprecated).
ui.7: Returns a data-change version number used to detect writes by other connections.
ui.8: Allows reading uncommitted data in shared cache mode.
ui.9: Performs extra integrity checks on page cells when set to 1.
ui.10: Disables trust of expressions in sqlite_schema when set to 0 (injection defense).
ui.11: Allows modifying the sqlite_schema table when set to 1 (dangerous).
ui.12: Skips CHECK constraint verification when set to 1.
ui.13: Database text encoding; must be set before the first database creation.
ui.14: Runs cleanup incrementally by page in INCREMENTAL mode.
ui.15: Sets auto-vacuum mode to reclaim space freed by deletions.
ui.16: Returns the compile-time options of SQLite (which features are enabled).
ui.17: Schema version number, auto-incremented on structural changes.
ui.18: Application ID written to the file header for external programs to identify.
ui.19: User-defined version number, commonly used for schema migration management.
ui.20: Defers foreign key checks to commit time within a transaction.
ui.21: Enables foreign key constraints (off by default; must be set per connection).
ui.22: Sets the auxiliary thread pool size (defaults to half the CPU core count).
ui.23: Sets a soft heap memory limit; caches are released when exceeded.
ui.24: Sets a hard heap memory limit; allocation fails when exceeded.
ui.25: Sets the directory for temporary database files (deprecated).
ui.26: Storage location for temp tables and indexes; MEMORY is faster but not persistent.
ui.27: Milliseconds to wait on table lock conflicts before returning SQLITE_BUSY.
ui.28: Whether to overwrite deleted content with zeros to prevent data residue recovery.
ui.29: EXCLUSIVE mode holds locks until the connection closes, reducing lock contention.
ui.30: Sets disk sync policy: NORMAL balances performance and safety, FULL is safest.
ui.31: Manually runs a WAL checkpoint, merging WAL content back into the main database.
ui.32: Sets the WAL auto-checkpoint threshold; 0 disables auto-checkpoints.
ui.33: Limits the rollback journal file size, truncating when exceeded.
ui.34: Sets the journal mode; WAL mode offers the best concurrent read/write performance.
ui.35: When set to 0, allows transaction cache overflow without writing to disk, at your own risk.
ui.36: Sets the default page cache size for subsequent connections (persisted to the database file).
ui.37: Sets the maximum bytes for memory-mapped I/O, which can significantly boost read performance.
ui.38: Returns the total number of pages in the database file.
ui.39: Returns the number of free pages in the freelist available for reuse.
ui.40: Limits the maximum number of pages in the database file.
ui.41: Database page size; must be set before the first database creation, default 4096.
ui.42: Sets the page cache size per connection; -2000 means 2MB.
ui.43: Enables / disables recursive triggers; off by default.
ui.44: When set to 1, returns results in reverse order for queries without ORDER BY, exposing sorting dependencies.
ui.45: Sets query result column names to the bare column name only.
ui.46: Sets whether query result column names include the table name prefix.
ui.47: Sets whether LIKE is case-sensitive; by default it is not within ASCII.
ui.48: When set to 1 the database is read-only and all writes are rejected.
ui.49: Only verifies indexes and content, skipping page checks; faster than integrity_check.
ui.50: Fully verifies database integrity (indexes, content, pages); the full scan is slow.
ui.51: Returns full column info of an index, including sort order and key flags.
ui.52: Returns the columns covered by an index.
ui.53: Returns a list of all indexes on a table.
ui.54: Checks the whole database (or a specified table) for foreign key violations.
ui.55: Returns the foreign key definitions of a table.
ui.56: Lists the attached databases (main / temp / attached).
ui.57: Lists tables and views in the database (SQLite 3.37+).
ui.58: Returns column definition info of a table, commonly used to fetch table structure dynamically.
ui.100: Please click a PRAGMA card first
ui.101: Search PRAGMA name or description, e.g. journal / cache / foreign keys
